bullets.content: [general] Submit rule when below target (g<2): choose the solve minimising estimated_error x sqrt(DOFs/automesher_DOFs). A 1.12x DOF saving does not pay for error rising 11.3% to 12.7% (score 0.558 vs 0.522).

[general] Under a fixed load, displacement-FE strain energy rises toward exact as mesh converges. Solve 1 (2.1162e-4) beat solve 3 (2.1044e-4), matching true errors 11.3% vs 12.7%; solve 2 (2.1355e-4) beat solve 3 (2.1285e-4), compare diff 6.4%. Use strain energy as tie-breaker.

[general] compare stress_diff is the change between meshes, not an equal accuracy loss; treat it as an upper-bound proxy for the coarser mesh's extra error. With strain energy flat, submit the cheaper solve. Score candidates by estimated g/(2c).
[general] Do not judge a run by the solver's eta estimate: eta said 8.9% but true field error was 12.7%. Use compare stress_diff between meshes as convergence evidence.

[general] Never compare a solve with itself or repeat a compare. After each solve n: compare(n, best), then view(kind=error) and write top-5 hotspot share and local h vs requested size before the next mesh(). Skipped twice already.

[general] Change ONE factor per solve, other refinements byte-identical to baseline. Diff the refinement list against base before each mesh() call and state the single change; multi-change solves give unattributable differences.

[general] Use all 4 solves: (1) assigned variant, (2) fixed fine reference or energy-gain comparison, (3) best-guess efficient candidate, (4) one-factor distinct refinement of the winner. Never leave a solve unused (repeated); an unused solve forfeits a candidate.

[general] Read compare's nearest_reentrant_edge: when the top changed region is <=3 mm from a re-entrant edge, refine that edge {edge:tag,size:<=0.5x local h,radius:2x size} rather than resizing a saturated box.
[general] Use solves for distinct one-factor tests (+y extension, coarser box, hidden-point box), not near-duplicates. Copying earlier recipes gets no hidden-point bonus; add one distinct refinement.
[general] Use one solve as a DOF-trim test with a single change (e.g. coarser bottom box); compare to best solve and choose by error x sqrt(DOFs).
[general] Before planning, reread your own task notes. You broke your own 'keep h 0.008' note and repeated the loss. List each of your own avoid-notes that the planned recipe touches.

[general] Call compare() on at least one pair of different solves every run (cheapest vs finest). Read stress_diff_energy_norm_rel and the named regions before choosing. Required for order comparison, where energy alone mixes stiffness bias with discretisation error.
[general] Read signs in DOF/energy comparisons: write each delta as (new-old)/old. A 14% DOF cut with -2% energy (pay ratio 0.14 > 0.075) is rejected.

[general] Order-1 sizing on 3D tets: matching P2 DOFs needs ~2.6-3x more vertices; scale every size by ~0.5-0.6 and verify nodes with mesh(). P1 quality stays high (0.17-0.29). Risk: P1 energy runs 5-7% below P2 (locking/stiffness).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Next call: mesh(h=0.0045, order=2, refinements=[{group:f2,size:0.0025,radius:0.005},{edge:39,size:0.002,radius:0.005},{edge:8,size:0.002,radius:0.005},{box:[-0.0175,-0.0175,0.019,0.0175,0.0175,0.031],size:0.0032,radius:0.004}]). This is a4's recipe plus one f20-saddle box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a4: h 0.0045, edges 39/8 at 0.002 r0.005, f2 0.0025 r0.005 gave 16.1% field and 5.3% check-point error at 26.8k DOFs, beating graded coarse-h recipes. Finer root edges beat face groups.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Do not refine f20 or f23 as whole groups: 4071+3290 elements, 28k DOFs (4.6x automesher, 1.76x gain) while boss-root hotspots stayed h 0.0046-0.0051. Limit wall refinement to the box z 0.019-0.031.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Face refinements on f16/f19 at 0.0035 under h 0.01 left h 0.0046-0.005 at hotspots ~1 mm inside the root. Edges 39/8 at 0.002 reached them better (h 0.0038-0.0044). Junction rings and f20 shoulder z 0.021-0.029 held hotspots 1-5.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z~0.056 holds 15-18% of error in every run. Edge 3 at 0.0025 left f2 touching h 0.00463 (local errors 670-760%). Keep {group:f2,size:0.0025,radius:0.005} (h 0.0034); don't swap for edge 3.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Budget gate: a4 base gives 8947 nodes (26.8k DOFs). If box variant exceeds 11000 nodes (~33k DOFs), raise box size to 0.0036. At 30k DOFs need e<14.6% to beat a4's 0.221 (estimate). Also test h 0.014 with only junction refinement (~12k DOFs) in one solve.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edge refinements of size 0.003 under local h 0.0035 do nothing. Make edge sizes at least 2x finer than local h, or drop them.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top cap f25 (z~0.056) has tiny-stress cells with 220-760% relative error, each ~4% of error energy. It is cheap: try size 0.005 instead of 0.0039.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Order-1 variant = a3's g6 recipe (7073 P2 nodes) with h and every size x0.55. Aim 6500-7500 nodes; if <6000 use x0.5, if >8000 x0.6. Check min_quality >=0.1.

[abc_00000003_bc7] P1 pass line: needs strain energy >=0.0334 J at <=22k DOFs (P2 gives 0.03339-0.03359). a3's g5 P1 gave 0.0226 J (32% stiff). If P1 stays below 0.0330 J, record shortfall and submit P2 fallback.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: s1 P1 at matched DOFs; s2 P1 at sizes x0.47 (~1.6x nodes) for energy slope; s3 P2 fallback; compare(s1,s3), compare(s1,s2). Submit by energy-per-DOF evidence, not order preference.

[abc_00000003_bc7] P2 fallback: g6 zoned frame with junction box [-0.024,-0.02,0.018,0.024,0.02,0.038] at 0.0033 instead of 0.0038. Expect f16/f19 rims h ~0.0043, junction mid cells <15.2%. Ensure node count differs >1% from known meshes.
[abc_00000003_bc7] A box at 0.0038 inside 0.0054/0.0056 zones (0.70x) left f16 at 0.0056 and rim hotspots at h 0.005-0.0053 (22-23% VM error). Always request <=0.6x the enclosing size.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 at 0.0024 r0.004 atop a junction box: +6% nodes, energy 0.033539->0.033525. Rim hotspots sit 0.5-1.1 mm off f16/f19, beyond edges. Don't retest; use boxes around the rim.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring saturated: dropping top zone z0.036-0.0575 cost -2.0% energy for -14% DOFs (fails); top 0.0056->0.0046 gave +0.03% for +6% DOFs. Keep top zone 0.0054-0.0056 with f2+edge40 at 0.0025.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a15: zoned frame plus flank boxes [0.012,-0.013,0.021,0.024,0.013,0.034] and mirror at 0.003 r0.004 gave junction mid cells 2.4-3.0%, rims h 0.0042. Rim fix for P2.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Zoned coarse body at 20.8k DOFs gave 17.7%, worse than edges 39/8 at 0.002 (16.1% at 26.8k). Graded boxes alone don't buy accuracy; test h 0.012 with edges and no body box.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Nodes 5983->7372 changed energy <2%: diminishing returns near 20k DOFs. Gains need targeted refinement, not uniform DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never use global h 0.007 on box recipes: lost repeatedly (8.88% at 16.3k, 8.86% at 17.0k; e·DOFs 1450/1503 vs 1394 for a4 at h 0.008) as it thins f1/f4/f8/f53/f36/f37 by 10-17%. Use h 0.008.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp root layer z -0.0081..-0.0066 (x 0.014-0.029, |y|<0.016) is saturated at h 0.0022-0.0026: ~33-45% of error at only 4-5% VM error. Keep a4's single strip box 0.0016 r0.007, add no DOFs, don't go below 0.002.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp layer holds the error: hotspots #1-#4 at z~-0.0073 (f5/f7 bottoms) hold 35-40% at h 0.0025, VM error only 4-5%. a14 tier1 0.0016 gave h 0.0022, 8.06%. In P1 tier1 needs <=0.001. Optionally coarsen 0.0018 box to 0.0022 to save DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Upper f5 bore wall z~+0.0066 (hotspot #5 (0.0179,-0.0104,0.0066)) holds 3.5-3.9% at h 0.0047-0.0049 under upper box 0.004-0.0045. Request <=0.0036 (a4's 0.0038 gave compare 0.061 for +4% DOFs) over z 0.004-0.0081.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Before every solve(), re-issue the exact candidate mesh() as the last call and check solve 'nodes' equals its count. A solve ran the h 0.002 P1 mesh (7487 nodes) instead of 5667, losing a controlled experiment. View error on the P2 mesh you will submit; act on hotspots >=3% with local h >1.3x request.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Field and point errors tie within 0.4 points (a2 8.12 vs 7.77; hidden RMS 7.46%): both bind. Calibration: compare(h0.007, 27.6k ref)=0.0718 vs true 8.88% (ratio 1.24). Rank by 1.25×compare×DOFs; best 1419-1463, above ~1500 loses base. Submit lowest P2 candidate.
